one_change.admissible_prefix: retain v15's exact optimistic-bound early abort for the accuracy trajectory
one_change.trigger: only after the accuracy trajectory completes, require exclusive disagreement between commit-path evidence and bidirectional full-draft verification
one_change.localization: choose the single generation block with the largest verifier margin opposing path evidence
one_change.branch: preserve the selected parent everywhere else; re-mask and top1-rediffuse only fast/accuracy disagreements inside that block
one_change.acceptance: accept only when bidirectional parent-versus-repair verification strictly prefers the repaired draft
one_change.code_guard: reject a repair that regresses prompt-visible checks or loses compile validity on a pass tie

early_abort_contract.claim: when v15 aborts the accuracy trajectory, v18 returns the same fast tokens and NFE and never invokes the verifier or repair

queue_gate_audit.information_policy: the correction changes scheduling only, not generation logic or its inputs, and does not inspect any candidate-frozen suffix label
